text: Pursuant to 2010.CD32.2, City Council authorized the transfer of twenty of Toronto Community Housing Corporation’s scattered houses to Wigwamen Incorporated to enable solutions to housing issues facing vulnerable persons in a Council designated priority group. On August 1, 2025, Metrolinx expropriated 429 Pape Avenue, one of the scattered housing sites, from Wigwamen Incorporated to advance the construction of the Ontario Line. 429 Pape Avenue had been operated by Wigwamen Incorporated since 2010 as a single-family home. Since the expropriation, the City has been working collaboratively with Wigwamen to identify alternative sites to replace 429 Pape Avenue, with a particular focus in Ward 14.
